# Awarse Labs Documentation

> Local-first AI developer tools for FinOps and Playwright QA automation.

## Core Guides
- [Playwright Self-Healing Locators](https://awarselabs.com/docs/healwright/playwright-self-healing-locators): Ephemeral locator remediation with FastMCP.
- [SeatPrune Quickstart](https://awarselabs.com/docs/seatprune/quickstart): Automated M365 and GitHub license reclamation.
